tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rin chen shog ser gyi skor rig 'dzin

mchog sgrub bzhugs soḥ rig 'dzin mchog sgrub ces bya ba: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo: de nyid grub phyir sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: mchog dang thun mong rnam pa gnyis su brjod: bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa: 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa dang gsum: dang po la gsum las: sngon 'gro ni: dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su: rgyas pa'i dus : ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: a ru ra: ba ru ra: skyu ru ra: gla rtsi: ghi wang : gur gum: li shi: cu gang : rgya tsha: rgyam tsha: kha ru tsha: pi pi ling: shing mngar: go snyod: a ba: dbang lag: rtag tu ngu: a ka ru nag po: tsan+dan dkar dmar: sbrul sha: da bya ིda rnams phye mar btags te: mu zi ser pos dngul chu btul ma dang bsres la: ka ra: bu ram: sbrang rtsi gsum gyis dril te ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam byas la: rin po che'i snod du blugs te: maṇ+ḍal pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du bzhag: mtha' skor du mchod pa yang bsham mo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni: zla ba yar gyi tshes gcig gi tshe: dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa du yod kyis tshogs te: nyi ma rtse shar nas sgrub pa'i mgo bo brtsam mo: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas: rang nyid rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa ljang ser rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par mos la: stong pa'i ngang las gnas de nyid bde ba can du bsam pa'i nang du: ril bu rnams 'od du zhu ba las skad cig gis: pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du: tshe dpag med dmar po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thog pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung mnyam gzhag dang bcas pa'i phyogs bzhir: sman gyi lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi yang sman gyi bum pa bzung ste bzhengs nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam la:

ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas: dngos dang yid kyis mchod de: ā+oṃ ā yu ṣe a ma ra ni dzi wā na ti ye swā hā: zhes ci 'grub brjod pas: phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa': nyi zla rtsi shing nags tshal: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tshe dang : gzi brjid dang : dbang phyug thams cad bsdus te de nyid du thim par gyur: sman gyi lha mo bzhi las 'od 'phros pas: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i dngos grub bsdus te: de nyid du thim par bsam zhing bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par zhag nyi shu rtsa cig tu bya'o: grub pa'i rtags su sman rnams 'phel ba dang : ngad kyis thams cad khyab pa dang : rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba dang : sman gyi ri la 'dzegs pa dang : me tog 'thu ba la sogs pa'o: sgrub pa thon dus ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ril bur mos par bya'o: gsum pa rjes ni: ril bu de nyid tho rangs lnga lnga zos te: sngar gyi dmigs pa dang sngags kyi sgom bzlas byas pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa dang : nad kyi rigs thams cad zhi zhing mi 'byung ba dang : sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa 'phags pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang : mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin bzhin du 'du bas stongs grogs byed pa dang : zhi ba dang : rgyas pa dang : dbang dang : drag po'i phrin las thogs pa med par 'grub pa dang : gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang : longs spyod rab tu rgyas pa dang : shes rab 'phel ba dang : lha'i rigs 'du zhing mthong ba dang : ci bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'o: bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa rdzogs so: a+thi+-i: rgya rgya rgya: ༵༵༵gnyis pa 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa ni: dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su: stan bde ba la 'dug ste: skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas: skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las: pad+ma dmar po dang : nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros snang srid snod bcud thams cad 'od dmar po gcig tu gyur pa hrīḥl thim pa yongs su gyur pa las:

rang nyid slob dpon chen po nyi ma 'od zer dmar po tshe'i myu gu dang bum pa bsnams pa: rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa: yum gsang ba ye shes dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang zhal sbyor ba: spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa: 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i phyogs bzhi: ha ri ni sa bzhi las tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dmar ser sems dpa'i skyil krung rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa: thams cad kyis phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa: gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'o: de nas ye shes pa bcug la: de thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na hrīḥre bsam pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'od dang : gzi brjid tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus la: rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥl thim pas rang nyid tshe yi rig 'dzin thob: tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa thob par bsam zhing : 'og rlung drag tu 'then: steng rlung cung zad mnan la: spyi bo nas dngas ma dkar dmar babs pas lus thams cad bde stong du mer khengs par bsam zhing : rlung bum pa can bskyil lo: bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni: hrīḥlas hrīḥ'i phreng ba yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du song bas: yum gyi mkha' nas yab kyi gsang bar zhugs te: snying ga'i hrī'i zhabs su thim pa 'gal me ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang : sangs rgyas dang : byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang : dpa' bo dang dpa' mo 'jig rten gyi lha klu rig 'dzin: nyi ma: zla ba: rtsi shing : nags tshal la sogs pa'i tshe dang : shes rab dang : bsod nams dang : gzi brjid thams cad bsdus te: snying ga'i hrīḥl thim pas: rang nyid tshe'i dngos grub nyi zla dang mnyam pa thob par bsam zhing : hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥzhes grangs med pa bzlas so: thun 'jog khar snang srid snod bcud thams cad sngags phreng la thim:

sngags phreng hrīḥl thim: 'khor bzhi yab yum dang bcas pa gsal btab la: sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba byas te: sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas langs so: thun mtshams su gtor ma ji ltar 'byor pa bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la: mdun du lha de rnams gsal gdab ste: ā+oṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa āḥhūm̐ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: lnga'am bdun gyis phul bas mnyes par bsam la: mgron rnams rang la bsdus te bsngo ba bya' : de lta bu'i sgrub pa lo re la zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig re ma chag par bya'o: zhag re bzhin tho rang dmigs pa thun re ma chags par bya'o: grub pa'i rtags su: nas la sogs pa 'bru'i phung po dang : nyi zla shar ba dang : me tog thu ba dang : nam langs pa dang : gos dkar po dri ma med pa gyon pa dang : chu bo'i rgyun la 'thung zhing khrus byed pa dang : nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa rmi'o: lo drug bsgoms na 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin grub bo: deng song tshe la long med skar mda' 'dra: zab mo'i dgongs gter nyams len mthar mi phyin: de phyir grub pa thob pa shin tu nyung : 'di ni 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub mchog: rig 'dzin sa la snyegs phyir snying phyung nas: phyi rabs snying tig spyod pa'i cha rkyen du: dri med 'od zer bdag gis legs par bkod: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa rdzogs so: a+thi+-i: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa la gnyis las: nyin mo 'od gsal mkha' la dbyung ba ni: bzhugs stangs gsum gyis mngon sum gyi don la ma yengs par bya'o: gnyis pa mtshan mo 'od gsal sbubs su sba ba ni: lus ni lha yi dkyil 'khor la: skra sen ye shes me ri 'bar: yan lag sgo bzhi rta babs bcas: mgo bo gtsang khang phyur bu la: mig sogs dbang po rnam pa lnga: rtsig pa lnga dang rgyan rnams rdzogs: de dus snying ga pad+ma dang : nyi ma zla ba'i dbus dag na: 'od kyi 'khor lo mu khyud lnga:

'od zer nyi ma stong 'dra zhing : gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: de dbus rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas ni: rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung : snang mtha' don yod grub pa rnams: kun bzang mā ma kī dang niḥ sangs rgyas spyan dang gos dkar mo: dam tshig sgrol dang mnyam par sbyor: mthing ga dkar ser dmar ljang zhing: rdo rje skyil krung rgyan rnams rdzogs: 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang : pad+ma rgya gram 'dzin pa 'o: zur bzhir sems dpa' sems ma brgyad: sgo bzhir sgo ba yab yum bzhi: so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhin: yang na 'od kyi gong bu bsam: steng du khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'od lnga'i gdangs te 'khril sbyor nyid: yang na 'od kyi 'khor lo bsam: snying dbus 'od kyi 'khor lo na: rigs lnga yab yum 'od gsal sku: snang la rang bzhin med pa la: steng 'og phyogs mtshams lha rnams kun: 'od kyi gong bu 'od zer 'phro: gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan par bsgom: des ni 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags: rmi lam zin dang med pa dang : rigs lnga'i zhing khams snang ba dang : rnam rtog ma lus dbyings su nub: nyin mtshan 'od kyi 'khor lor snang : lha la sogs pa'i gzugs mthong dang : sgra snyan dri mchog sngon med snang : tha mal snang ba nub pa dang : ci snang gzugs brnyan 'dra ba dang : phyi nang zang thal mthong ba 'o: de ltar goms pas skal ldan de: brtson 'grus rab kyis tshe 'dir grol: 'bring rnams bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas: tha ma'ang rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing : mngon du gyur nas rdzogs sangs rgyas: de nyid rtags su skal ldan de: 'das dus sku gdung ring bsrel dang : 'ja' 'od sna tshogs 'byung bar nges: 'di rnams rnal 'byor skal ba rab: sku gdung ring bsrel 'ja' 'od ni: nges par 'di yis 'grub pa yin: rjes 'jug spro ba mchog tu skyed: gdams pa'i snying po yang zab 'di: skal ldan gcig las mang ba na:

mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'byung bar nges: de phyir rang nyid nyams su longs: ma spel snying du rgya yis gdab: 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa 'di: rig 'dzin mchog gi sgrub pa yin: de phyir yang gsang snying la sba: 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: a+thi+-i: de yang 'di lta bu'i gsang sngags mthar thug pa'i chos dang 'phrad pa'i skal ldan de nyid rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin yin la: des zab mo'i don rdzogs par nyams su len pa'i phyir: 'chi med 'grub pa ni tshe'i rig 'dzin yin: de'i rten la gdams pa'i don mngon du gyur pas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yin la: de nyid mthar phyin nas 'og min du sangs rgya ba'i tshe: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin yin no: 'dir mkha' 'gro snying tig gi skal ldan gcig la bzhi ka tshangs te: sngon nas las 'phro'i rnam pa tshe 'dir smin nas 'di dang 'phrad pas rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin: brtson 'grus rab kyi 'od lus grub pas tshe la dbang thob: 'bring dang tha mas 'od gsal mchog gi tshe la dbang thob pas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin: mngon sum gyi snang ba mthong bas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin: de nyid cis kyang gdod ma'i sar grol bar nges pas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin: des na 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med do : e ma ho: mkha' 'gro snying tig bka' gsang rgya che las: shin tu zab mo'i gnad bsdus bcud phyung ba: don gyi snying po 'od gsal mchog gi lam: gang dang mi 'dra kun gyis ma rtogs pa: tshig don mtha' dag rdzogs par bdag la babs: bdag nyid snying la rgyas btab sba snyam pas: tho rangs bud med g.yu yi lan tshar can: shin tu mdzes pa'i gzugs can zhig na re: phyi rabs skal ldan don du spel cig gsungs: de nas bdag gis zab mo'i gnad rnams kun: shog ser ngos la lhag chad med par bkod: phyi rabs las can rnams dang 'phrad par shog:

rig 'dzin mchog sgrub ces bya ba: dri med 'od zer gyis o rgyan rdzong du bkod pa rdzogs so: bkra shis: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)rig 'dzin mchog sgrub/ - PAGE 36 -- PAGE 35 -- PAGE 29 -
